title: PowerGrid Field Manual
summary: Build stable loops with generation, storage, cables, substations, meters, and breaker discipline.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: PowerGrid makes energy a network you can reason about. A stable grid has generation, storage, clear cable tiers, metering, protection, and enough room to expand.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Start with one generator, one storage block, one consumer, and a meter. Confirm power flow before adding machines or long cable runs.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Generate power, buffer it, distribute it through appropriate cables, monitor demand, isolate overloads, and upgrade the weakest segment before adding new load.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Battery banks buffer spikes, substations organize lines, breakers protect failures, meters explain the current state, and diagnostic tools identify why a consumer is offline.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Industrial Nexus and Logistics depend on reliable energy. TutorialCore can mark power alerts, Index can explain blocks, and Wiki pages can link machine symptoms to grid causes.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If machines stall, check generator fuel, cable continuity, voltage tier, storage level, breaker state, and consumer demand. Most outages are a missing link or overloaded segment.
